name: Experience-memory nightly beat
description: Blueprint: the experience-memory pull-beat (mine + propose). Scans data/workflow-runs and session transcripts for failed/successful trajectory pairs, mines corrections into the hash-chained store, and prints genesis graduation cards for any promoted corrections. PULL ONLY — never dispatches fleet work. Schedule it via a chrono kind=workflow schedule; run it by hand with `node scripts/experience-mine.mjs`. Honest counts land in data/experience-memory/state/last-beat.json and on the bus as @agentruntime/experience-memory:beat. Non-zero exit propagates: the beat failing IS the signal.
